beats.label: S1 · A spy in the school
beats.text: Daisy is a Mayday operative undercover as a Pearl Girl trainee at Aunt Lydia's school, working with MacKenzie Guardian Garth to infiltrate Gilead's elite.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the show's central premise — Mayday has a girl inside the machine — and the Garth/Daisy pipeline that runs the whole season.

beats.label: S1 · Doctor Grove
beats.text: Green Girl Agnes is drugged and molested by Doctor Grove during dental visits, and Gilead's culture of silence keeps her assault buried.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The wound that radicalises Agnes and drives every choice she and Becka make in the back half of the season.

beats.label: S1 · Lydia's dossier
beats.text: A flashback shows Lydia bought her place in Gilead by taking part in the stadium executions; she has since compiled a secret dossier of the elite's crimes.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the season's second concealed weapon — Lydia's file — and signals that the woman running the school is no longer a true believer.

beats.label: S1 · The Japan deal
beats.text: Mayday learns Commander MacKenzie is secretly brokering an arms deal with sanctioned Japan, and Daisy is ordered to grow closer to his daughter Agnes.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the geopolitical mission that pushes Daisy across the line from observer to embedded ally of Agnes.

beats.label: S1 · The ball
beats.text: The matchmaking ball pairs Agnes with Commander Weston, the violent head of the Eyes, and matches Garth with her best friend Becka instead of her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Locks in the season's romantic and political misalignments — Agnes engaged to a monster, Garth on the wrong side of the family — that force every later move.

beats.label: S1 · Grove falls
beats.text: Daisy fakes an assault by Grove to expose him, Becka drowns her father in the bathtub, and Mrs. Grove is executed as the scapegoat to spare Becka.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season's first real strike against a Commander, and the moment Daisy, Agnes, Becka and Lydia are all quietly implicated in the same conspiracy.

beats.label: S1 · The Hannah reveal
beats.text: Daisy tells Agnes that she is Hannah, June Osborne's stolen daughter, and sends June word that she will rally Gilead's girls to finish what her mother started.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Turns a covert intelligence operation into an internal insurgency, and hands the next chapter to the three girls walking the corridor with linked pinkies.

cliffhanger.text: Three girls stand united inside Aunt Lydia's school and Daisy has sent June word that she will finish what her mother started. Lydia sits on a dossier that could burn down the regime, MacKenzie's Japan arms deal is still hidden, and a humiliated Weston is now an enemy.
questions: Can Daisy turn the Green Girls at Aunt Lydia's school into a real movement from the inside?
Will Lydia's dossier become a weapon against Gilead's elite, or her insurance to survive them?
What will Commander Weston do now that Agnes has publicly slipped his grasp?

characters.name: Daisy / Hannah
characters.line: Pearl Girl trainee who is secretly a Mayday operative and June Osborne's daughter, smuggled to Canada as a baby and now embedded back inside Gilead.

characters.name: Agnes MacKenzie
characters.line: Green Girl assaulted by Dr. Grove and jilted by Commander Weston; has just learned that her own real name was hidden from her.
characters.note: Her original name is confirmed by Lydia but never spoken on screen in the source.

characters.name: Aunt Lydia
characters.line: Head of the school for Gilead's Aunts, compiling a secret dossier of elite crimes and increasingly disillusioned with the regime she helped build.

characters.name: Aunt Vidala
characters.line: Lydia's rival among the Aunts who, after the Grove affair, offered to help Lydia rather than stand against her.

characters.name: Commander Judd
characters.line: Founding Son of Jacob quietly pushing to replace Lydia; dismisses violence against girls with callous indifference.

characters.name: Commander MacKenzie
characters.line: Agnes's adoptive father who is secretly brokering an arms deal with sanctioned Japan while showing her genuine paternal affection.

characters.name: Commander Weston
characters.line: Violent head of the Eyes; broke off his engagement to Agnes on learning she had been assaulted, and is now personally humiliated.

characters.name: Becka Grove
characters.line: Agnes's best friend, in love with her; murdered her father Dr. Grove and was married off to Garth to keep her safe.

characters.name: Garth
characters.line: Former MacKenzie Guardian, now a Commander; Mayday's inside man and Becka's protective husband, still tied to Agnes.

characters.name: June Osborne
characters.line: Mayday leader in Boston and Daisy's mother; has just received her daughter's vow to keep fighting from inside Gilead.
